scope: Reviewed factory-HSI and ADC source facts. Values are conditional on the cited supply, ambient TA, factory trim, divider and channel/reference assumptions. No silicon measurements.
reference_convention: source_ref resolves to canonical original URL, SHA256, printed revision and separate cover/history/acquisition dates. PDF page numbers are 1-based and kept distinct from printed page numbers.
normalization: Classic ADC and low-family ADC fact keys retain their audit-specific names to avoid inventing equivalence for voltage boundary notation. HSI common fields are normalized across all 13 families.
temperature_scope_warning: Bounds use ambient TA, not junction temperature. The F/A-family HSI bound ends at +105 C although general operating tables can allow +125 C at low dissipation; no accuracy bound is claimed for +105..+125 C. The L-family HSI bound ends at +85 C although general conditions can permit +105 C; no accuracy bound is claimed for +85..+105 C. Use each family's exact cited interval.
source_revision_warning: F020 uses current-datasheets/CW32F020_DataSheet_CN_V1.3.pdf, printed Rev1.3 dated2025-12-30, SHA1e330d8..., not root legacy file printed Rev1.2 despite same V1.3 filename. Legacy source is not used for any conclusion.
